messages:
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] Initiating phased rollout v2.3.1 -> US=10%, EU=0%, APAC=0% (canary slice). Change window 2024-07-15 22:00-02:00 UTC. Rolling policy: steady 10% -> holdpoints.
Anya: Kicking off smoke on US slice, watching token-level latency and error rate.
Sam K: US warm pool warmed. p50 token latency 110ms, p95 220ms. No 5xx spikes. dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood/p/us-canary-17485
Leila: FYI EU reserved pool currently 24 GPUs, 80% allocated. If we ramp EU we may hit 85% within 20m under bursty traffic.
SRE Oncall: Eviction headroom at 12%. If warmpool drops <75% we'll start evictions. I'll keep thermal hooks open.
Marco: If EU warmpool crosses 85% we agreed to pin EU to v2.3.0 and throttle traffic. Confirming rollback plan?
Anya: yep. Pin -> throttle -> rollback if stability doesn't return in 10m.
Deploy Bot: US slice health update: 10% -> healthy. checks: ok=48/48, errs=0, avgCPU=29%. No alarms.
Leila: APAC has no reserved capacity for this release (0 GPUs). Need infra sign-off to burst.
Sam K: I can authorize a short burst of +6 GPUs for APAC for 30m if we need to start early. Ping @SRE Oncall for thermal OK.
SRE Oncall: +1 to short burst, will monitor thermal and inter-host pressure.
Ash: Release notes: https://redwood.in/releases/v2.3.1 — kernel selection tweaks, batching default change, KV-cache sticky opt-in. QA called out small output variance on long-context evals.
Marco: Defining rollback triggers: 1) p95 token latency >2x baseline for >=10m, 2) error rate >1% sustained over 5m, 3) GPU OOMs >=2 within 3m.
Sam K: Runbook snippets to execute if we need to pin/rollback:
```
redwoodctl pin --region eu --version v2.3.0
redwoodctl throttle --slice eu --percent 0
redwoodctl rollback --release v2.3.1 --reason "latency spike"
```
Leila: Starting pre-pin checklist for EU: taking model snapshots, ensuring audit logging open, notifying security team (done).
Anya: US stable for 20m. Recommend ramp EU to 5% now for sanity.
Deploy Bot: EU ramp command submitted -> target 5%. Current EU slice=0% -> transitioning.
SRE Oncall: Watching EU metrics. p50 130ms, p95 260ms, errs=0 in first 2m. No OOMs.
Ash: ML infra note: enable KV cache sticky on EU can reduce cold-start token overhead; consider toggling for this slice.
Marco: Hold EU at 5% for 15m. If stable, move to 15%. If any rollback trigger fires, pin EU immediately and throttle.
Leila: APAC infra still needs egress permission for release artifacts. I've pinged infra-priv for a fast-track.
Sam K: If EU holds, plan APAC start +2h to allow time for APAC warming and compliance signoff.
Anya: Acknowledged. I'll update #release-updates with the ramp status and brief note on the KV-cache recommendation.
Deploy Bot: EU holdpoint reached: 5% stable. Health: ok=12/12, errs=0, avgCPU=33%. Next check-in scheduled in 15m.
Leila: :thumbsup:
SRE Oncall: I'll keep the window monitored, will escalate if thermal or eviction thresholds move.
Marco: Great. Keeping this thread as the canonical ops log for this slice. Ping here before any manual pin/rollback so we have clear audit trail.
Anya: will do.
Sam K: thanks all — standing by for the 15m readout.
